notesStmt.note: Author: Sthiramati Collection / category: BuddhistNon-Scriptures / T07 (Abhidharma) Source: Aggregated by Sebastian Nehrdich (Dharmamitra) from the published critical editions of Kazuo Kano and collaborators (2020–2022). Only Sthiramati's constituted Sanskrit is reproduced here. Editions used (one per Abhidharmakośa verse): - *AK 4.34* — Kazuo Kano and Jowita Kramer, "The Fourth Chapter of the Tattvārthā Abhidharmakośaṭīkā: On Forbidding Intoxicating Liquor," in *Sanskrit Manuscripts from China III* (Proceedings of a panel at the 2016 Beijing International Seminar on Tibetan Studies), Beijing: China Tibetology Publishing House, 2020 (critical edition and diplomatic transcription at pp. 122–128). Textual basis: Constituted Sanskrit reading text of Sthiramati's Tattvārthā commentary on Abhidharmakośabhāṣya 4.34–4.37 (within the fourth chapter, Karmanirdeśa), covering folios 1r1–2r6 of the Sanskrit manuscript from Tibet (Ms. "A," copies of which are kept at the China Tibetology Research Center, Beijing). The text was aggregated across the four editions above and ordered by Abhidharmakośa verse (4.34 → 4.35 → 4.36ab → 4.36cd → 4.37). Where a verse was edited in more than one paper (4.35 and 4.36ab), the later Japanese editions' corrected Sanskrit was preferred. This etext contains only Sthiramati's constituted Sanskrit: the Abhidharmakośa kārikā/bhāṣya, Saṃghabhadra's *Nyāyānusāra* parallels, the Tibetan translation, the critical apparatus (variant readings), and the Japanese/English translations given in the source papers are not included. Bold AKBh lemmata are not separately marked. Segments are split at the daṇḍa; the manuscript folio side (1r/1v/2r) is recorded in the folio field.

bibl.note: Based on edition (determined): Aggregated from four published critical editions by Kazuo Kano and collaborators based on the Sanskrit manuscript preserved in Tibet: (1) AK 4.34 in Kano & Kramer, 'The Fourth Chapter of the Tattvārthā Abhidharmakośaṭīkā: On Forbidding Intoxicating Liquor', in Sanskrit Manuscripts in China III, ed. B. Kellner et al., Beijing: China Tibetology Publishing House, 2020, pp. 107–136; (2) AK 4.35 in Kano et al., Taihō zasshi 2 (2021): 63–98; (3) AK 4.36ab in Kano et al., Taihō zasshi 3 (2022): 43–95; (4) AK 4.36cd–4.37 in Kano & Kramer, China Tibetology 36.1 (2021): 81–99.

text.body:
punar aviśeṣeṇa madyapānasya duścaritatvaprasādhanārtham āha – prakṛtisāvadyaṃ madyam iti vinayadharāḥ |
yadi hi prakṛtisāvadyaṃ na syāt, madyociteṣu śākyeṣu glāneṣv abhyanujñātaṃ syāt, na cābhyanujñātam |
tasmāt prakṛtisāvadyaṃ prāṇivadhādivad iti |
yasyāryā janmāntareṣv akaraṇasaṃvaraṃ pratilabhante tat prakṛtisāvadyam, tadyathā prāṇātipātādattādānādaya iti |
kāyaduścaritavacanāc ca prakṛtisāvadyam, tadanyakāyaduścaritavat |
caturvidhaṃ hi kāyaduścaritam uktaṃ prāṇātipāto ’dattādānaṃ kāmamithyācāro madyapānam iti |
utsargavihitasyāpīti sāmānyavihitasya |
kathaṃ bhadanta glāna upasthātavyaḥ |
sthāpayitvā prakṛtisāvadyam ity ayam utsargaḥ |
śākyeṣu punar glāneṣv apavādaḥ prasaṅgaparihārārtham iti sakṛtpītam api madyaṃ vyasanībhavati |
uktaṃ hi bhagavatā – trīṇi sthānāni pratisevato nāsti tṛptiḥ, madyam abrahmacaryaṃ styānamiddhaṃ ceti |
santi hi kecit pratisaṃkhyānabahulā ye pratikārārtham amadanīyām eva mātrāṃ pibanti, teṣāṃ kimarthaṃ nānujñātam ity ata āha – madanīyamātrāniyamād iti |
dravyakālaprakṛtiśarīrāvasthāpekṣā hi saiva mātrā madanīyā cāmadanīyā ca bhavatīti |
pūrvavākyavyākhyānānusaṃdhinā cedam uktaṃ – madanīyamātrāniyamād iti |
ata eva kuśāgrapānapratiṣedha iti prasaṃgaparihārārtham |
katham |
prajñaptisāvadyam ity avetya, alpadoṣatvāt taratamābhivṛddhikrameṇāsya viśeṣaṇād yāvanmadanīyamātrāpānam api syād iti prasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ kuśāgrapratiṣedhaḥ |
eṣāṃ hi prasaṅga eva vicchidyate |
āryair anadhyācaraṇaṃ hrīmattvād iti pañca śaikṣabalāni sūtre paṭhyante – śraddhābalaṃ vīryabalaṃ hrībalam apatrāpyabalaṃ prajñābalaṃ ca |
ato hrīmattvān na pibanti |
hrīmadbhir na pātavyam ity atra kiṃ kāraṇam ity ata āha – tena ca smṛtināśād iti |
madyaṃ hi pibataḥ kāryākāryasmṛtir naśyati |
yady evam alpakaṃ yāvatyā smṛtir na naśyati, tat kimarthaṃ na pibatīty ata āha – alpakasyāpy apānam aniyamād viṣavat |
yathā kālaprakṛtiśaktiyogād alpam api viṣaṃ kadācin mārayati, evaṃ madyam api madayatīti |
arhadbhir anadhyācaritatvāt pratikṣepaṇasāvadyaṃ vikālabhojanādivan madyam ity ācāryasaṅghabhadraḥ |
etan nānavadyam ity ājñāyānadhyācaraṇāt |
duścaritavacanaṃ pramādasthānatvāt, na prakṛtisāvadyatvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
ata evātrety atra śikṣāpade – surāmaireyamadyapramādasthānaṃ prahāyeti |
nānyeṣv iti prāṇātipātādiviratiṣu |
agrahaṇe kāraṇam āha – prakṛtisāvadyatvād iti |
atyāseviteneti vistaraḥ |
uktaṃ hi sūtre – surāmaireyamadyapramādasthānenāsevitena bhāvitena bahulīkṛtena kāyasya bhedān narakeṣūpapadyata iti, ākṣepād apūrvasya, vṛttilābhād vā pūrvopacitasya maraṇāvasthāyāṃ |
sarvapramādāspādatvād iti sarvasmṛtisaṃpramoṣapramādānāṃ prāṇātipātādihetubhūtānāṃ madyapānam āspadabhūtaṃ punaḥ pramādasthānam iti |
kṛtyanirapekṣasyākṛtyapravaṇatā pramādaḥ |
tannimittaṃ pramādasthānaṃ |
madyapītas tadajīrṇe na saṃvaram ādadyāt, pramādasthānagatatvāt |
yata eko labhyata iti |
karmabhyo maulaprayogapṛṣṭhebhyo vastubhyaḥ sattvāsattvākhyebhyaḥ prakṛtipratikṣepaṇasāvadyebhyaś ceti praśnārthaḥ |
maulaprayogapṛṣṭhebhya iti |
karmapathānām ity abhisaṃbandhanīyam |
akuśalānāṃ karmapathānāṃ maulaprayogapṛṣṭhebhyaḥ tatpratipakṣabhūtāḥ prātimokṣasaṃvarākhyā avijñaptaya utpadyante yathāyogam |
sattvāsattvākhyebhya iti vastubhyaḥ |
prakṛtipratikṣepaṇasāvadyebhyaś ceti karmabhyaḥ |
etac ca pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate |
sattvāsattvākhyebhya iti |
katham asattvākhyaprakṛtisāvadyam |
jātarūpādyapaharaṇe, strīpratirūpair vābrahmacaryakaraṇe |
kathaṃ sattvākhyapratikṣepaṇasāvadyam |
sahāgāraśayyādiṣu |
śeṣaṃ tu prakṛtisāvadyaṃ prāṇātipātādi sattvādhiṣṭhānam, pratikṣepaṇasāvadyaṃ tṛṇacchedādy asattvādhiṣṭhānam |
tatpravṛttatvād iti |
yady atītānāgatebhyo ’pi labhyeta, evaṃ sati yo ’pi sattvākhyebhyo labhyate prāṇātipātādiviratisvabhāvaḥ, sa evāsattvākhyebhyo ’pi syād iti |
yady apy asattvādhiṣṭhāno ’pi prātimokṣasaṃvaro ’sti, sa tu sattvādhiṣṭhānavad vartamānebhya eva skandhadhātvāyatanebhyo labhyata iti sattvādhiṣṭhāna ity uktam, nāsattvādhiṣṭhānatvam asya pratiṣidhyate |
prādhānyād vā sattvādhiṣṭhānasyetarasya ca tadaṅgatvenopāttatvāt sattvādhiṣṭhāna ity uktam |
na prayogapṛṣṭhebhya iti samāhitāvasthāyām ekāntamaulatvād asamāhitāyāṃ ca saṃvarābhāvāt |
kuta eva prajñaptisāvadyebhya iti |
abhyupagamābhāvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
sarvakālebhyaś ceti vistaraḥ |
atītānāgatayor api saṃvarayor lābhāt, tatsahabhūcittavat |
ata eva catuṣkoṭikaṃ kriyata iti vistaraḥ |
yataḥ prātimokṣasaṃvaro vartamānebhya eva maulavat prayogapṛṣṭhebhyo ’pi prakṛtisāvadyavat pratikṣepaṇasāvadyebhyo ’pi labhyate, dhyānānāsravasaṃvarau tu vartamānavad atītānāgatabhyo ’pi labhyete, maulebhya eva na prayogapṛṣṭhebhyo nāpi pratikṣepaṇasāvadyebhya iti |
anye tu na saṃvaralābhakāle pratyutpannāḥ karmapathāḥ saṃbhavantīti pāṭhavikalpaṃ syur dharmāḥ, prātimokṣasaṃvara upalabhyante, na dhyānānāsravasaṃvare |
prathamā kotiḥ, yāḥ pratyutpannāḥ prayogapṛṣṭhaviratayaḥ prajñaptisāvadyaviratayaś ca labhyante |
dhyānānāsravasaṃvara evopalabhyante, na prātimokṣasaṃvare, atītānāgatebhyo maulebhyaḥ karmapathebhyo viratayaḥ |
tṛtīyā pratyutpannebhyo maulebhyaḥ karmapathebhyo viratayaḥ |
caturthy atītānāgatebhyaḥ sāmantakapṛṣṭhebhyo virataya iti |
atra ca sarvatra— karmapathādhiṣṭhāne karmapathaśabdaṃ saṃniveśya pūrvo ’pi catuṣko na duṣṭa iti manyante |
evaṃ ca kṛtvā vartamānātītānām api karmapathānāṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ yujyate |
nānāgatānām eva |
karmapathādhiṣṭhāne tacchabdasaṃniveśāt |
anyathānāgatānām eva saṃvaraṇaṃ yujyate |
saṃvarasāmarthyenānāgatāniṣṭakarmapathānutpatter nātītapratyutpannānām iti |
tadanya iti bhikṣusaṃvarād anyas trividho 'pi gṛhyate |
tatra hi trividhe 'py aviśeṣeṇa kāyikāt prāṇātipātādes trividhād vācikāc ca mṛṣāvādād eva viratir aṅgaṃ vyavasthāpyate |
alobhādveṣāmohā hi sarvasmin kuśale citte saha saṃbhavantīti mṛdumadhyādhimātrāṇi punaś cittāni paryāyeṇa bhavanti, na yugapad ity ata āha — kāraṇair apīti vistaraḥ |
asti saṃvarasthāyīti sarvādhikṛtaṃ veditavyaṃ |
na sarvāṅgair iti, upavāsopāsakaśrāmaṇerasaṃvareṣu paiśunyapāruṣyasambhinnapralāpaviratīnām abhāvāt |
na sarvakāraṇair iti yo mṛdvādinām cittānām anyatamena cittenopāsakasaṃvaraṃ samādatte, upavāsasaṃvaraṃ śrāmaṇerasaṃvaraṃ vā |
sarvasattvānugataḥ sarvasattvālaṃbanaḥ kalyāṇo 'nupaghātāśayo 'nugrahāśayo vā, avipratipannatvāt kalyāṇa ucyate |
pāpāśayasyānuparatatvād ity upaghātāśayasyānuparatatvāt |
katham aśakyebhya iti vistaraḥ |
yo hi yeṣāṃ jīvitasvadāravyavacchedam aśaktaḥ kartuṃ tasya tadviṣayaprāṇātipātādyasaṃbhavāt, tebhyaḥ prāṇātipātādiviratyātmakasaṃvaro na yujyata iti manyate |
sarvasattvajīvitānupaghātādhyāśayenābhyupagamād iti |
sarvasattveṣv anupaghātāśayasyāviśeṣāc chakyebhya ivāśakyebhyo ’pi labhyate |
anyathā vā suptamattamūrchitānāṃ sarvāśakyatvāt saṃvaratyāga eva syāt |
atha pratibaddhasya pratilabdhasaṃjñasya vāsti tadupaghāte śaktir iti |
aśakyeṣv api śakyabhāvāpanneṣv asti śaktir iti tulyam etat |
cayāpacayayuktaḥ syād iti |
aśakyānāṃ śakyeṣu manuṣyādiṣu saṃcārāc cayayuktaḥ syāt, apūrvasaṃvaralābhāt |
śakyādīnāṃ manuṣyādīnām aśakyeṣu devādiṣu saṃcārād apacayayuktaḥ syāt, pūrvapratilabdhasaṃvarāpagamāt |
evaṃ ca vināpi paravijñapanādibhir lābhakāraṇaiḥ śikṣānikṣepaṇādibhiś ca parityāgakāraṇaiḥ saṃvarasya lābhatyāgau syātām iti |
na |
sattvānāṃ pūrvaṃ paścāc ca bhāvād iti |
yathā pariśeṣa evam anyo 'pi bhaviṣyatīti manyate |
tad idaṃ vaidharmyamātreṇa pratyavasthānam asamartham |
atha tṛṇādīnāṃ sarvam abhāva eveṣyate, evam ihāpi saṃvarasya cayāpacayayogena sarvebhyas tṛṇādibhyaḥ saṃvara iti prasajyate |
kathaṃ saṃvarahrāso na syād iti viṣayābhāvād ity abhiprāyaḥ |
yadi parinirvṛtebhyaḥ saṃvarābhāvaḥ evaṃ tarhīti vistaraḥ |
atrācāryaḥ parihāram āha — sarveṣāṃ sarvasattvebhyo lābhād ityādi |
evam idānīṃ vaktavyam — buddhasantānāt pipīlikāsantānāc ca prāṇātipātādivirateḥ kim asti viśeṣo 'tha na |
kiṃ cātaḥ |
yady asti, gatyaniyatatvāt sattvānāṃ saṃvarasya cayāpacayaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha nāsti, kathaṃ manuṣyabadhāt pārajayikā, amanuṣyabadhāt sthūlātyayaḥ, tiryagyonibadhāt pāyattikā |
nāsti santānataḥ saṃvaraviśeṣa iti manyante |
daṇḍakarmaviśeṣas tu prayogaviśeṣād ity āhuḥ |
anyo hi manuṣye prayogo 'nyo yāvat pipīlike |
tulyāyām api tāvad gatau tulyāyām utpattau prayogataḥ karmanāṃ viśeṣo bhavati |
yathā hastinaṃ hatvā prabhūtataram apuṇyaṃ bhavati, alpataraṃ pipīlikam |
prāg evātulyāyām |
saṃvaras tv āśayato vyavasthāpyate, sarvasattvānugatakalyāṇāśaye vyavasthitasya tatprāpter iti |
na ca svasantānān maulakarmapathasaṃgṛhītaḥ saṃvaro labhyate |
mā bhūc cetanādharmādīnāṃ svavadhād ānantaryādiprasaṅgaḥ |
sāmantakasaṃgṛhītas tu na vāryate śukravisargaviratyādinaḥ |
asaṃvaras tu sarvebhya iti |
sarvakarmapathadvārabhūtaṃ duścaritam asaṃvara ucyate |
yadā tu labdhe ’saṃvare saṃcintya prāṇinaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayati so ’sya bhavati karmapatha iti vistareṇa sarvatra vācyaṃ |
yugapan mṛdvādicintāsaṃbhavād iti |
nanu yugapad rāgadveṣayor asaṃprayogād akuśalamūlānām api yugapad asaṃbhavaḥ, kimarthaṃ cittānām evocyate |
paścimaṃ paryāyaṃ niyamayya vacanād adoṣaḥ |
kim punar eka evaurabhrikaḥ kaukkuṭikaḥ saukarikaś ca syāt |
syād ity āha |
na tv evaṃ sarvakāraṇair asaṃvaro ’pi saṃvaraval labhyeta |
nāsāv apūrvam asaṃvaraṃ pratilabhate, prāṇātipātavijñaptayas tu tās tasya bhavantīty āhuḥ |
pūrvam evāsau sarvasattveṣv asaṃvṛtaḥ |
tadupaghātena jīvikābhyupagamāt |
kuta idānīm apūrvam asaṃvaraṃ pratilabhate |
upāsakasya tu śrāmaṇerasaṃvaraḥ śrāmaṇerasya ca bhikṣusaṃvaro ‘pūrva utpadyate |
samādānakarmapathatatparivāraviśeṣād iti |
adhimātraṃ prāṇātipātavijñaptyetiavijñaptyā .. .. .. .. ceti coccāryam |
nāgabandhāḥ hastipakāḥ |
daṇḍanetāro ye daṇḍaṃ hiraṇyaṃ cārinaṃ vā niyamayanti, dharmapāṭhakādayo mantriṇo vā daṇḍanetāraḥ |
arthata iti prakṛtitulyatvād apaṭhitā api āsaṃvarikā boddhavyāḥ |
tatrasthatayeti, naite asaṃvare saṃbhūtā iti asaṃvare bhavāḥ, kiṃ tarhi asaṃvarasthitatayeti |
vidvāṃsa iti jānānāḥ |
āryībhūtānāṃ ceti vistaraḥ |
na hi dṛṣṭasatyasyāpāyopapattir astīti |
urabhrān api te putrībhūtān iti vistaraḥ |
atrācāryasaṃghabhadraḥ parihāram āha |
yathā parasvam adattam asvīkurvataḥ svadārasaṃtuṣṭasya ekasyacid aurabhrikasyāśayasya vipannatvāt sarvāṅgebhyo ’saṃvaralābho bhavati, evaṃ sarvasatvebhyo ’pi bhaviṣyaty āśayasyaiva vipannatvād iti |
atra ca vṛttikāreṇaiva dattam uttaram iti nātrādaraṃ kriyate |
nāsti vikalaḥ prādesikāś cāsaṃvara iti |
vikalaḥ karmapathāṅgavaikalyāt |
prādeśikaḥ sattvadeśakālasamayaniyamayuktaḥ ||
anyatrāṣṭavidhād iti prātimokṣasaṃvaram aṣṭavidhaṃ varjjayitvā prādeśiko vikalo ’pi syāt |
tanmātraśīladauḥśīlyapratibandhanāt tanmātreṇa śīlena tanmātrasya dauḥśīlyasya pratibandhanāt, tanmātreṇa ca dauḥśīlyena tanmātrasya śīlasya pratibandhanād iti |
sa evāha |
evaṃ hy āsaṃvariko ’py upāsakaḥ, upāsakaś cāsaṃvarika iti prasajyate |
etac cābādhakaṃ sautrāntikasya |
tasya hi śaraṇagamanamātraḥ saṃvaram antareṇāpy upāsakaḥ, sa idānīṃ yasmāt prāṇātipātāder nivartate yatra ca pravartate, tatra yadi saṃvṛto ’saṃvṛtaś ca bhavati, kim atra bādhyate |
tatkulīnair ity aurabhrikādyāsaṃvarikakulīnaiḥ |
kṣetrādānādarehanād iti |
īhanam iti pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate |
kṣetrehanam ādānehanam ādarehanaṃ ca kṣetrādānādarehanaṃ |
atra ca ādānam evehanam iti samāsaḥ |
īhanaṃ punaś ceṣṭā |
